description: This file defines the CurlFactory class responsible for creating, configuring, and managing cURL handles for HTTP requests using the GuzzleHttp library. It handles setup for different HTTP versions, SSL options, headers, request body, proxy, and error handling logic.

classes.name: CurlFactory
classes.description: Implements creation and management of cURL handles for executing HTTP requests, including configuring options for different protocols, handling SSL, headers, request bodies, and error recovery within GuzzleHttp.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and configures a new cURL handle based on the provided HTTP request and options, including setting headers, method, body, and protocol version.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases or reuses a cURL handle, closing or resetting it based on cache and maximum handle limits.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes a cURL request, returning a fulfilled or rejected promise depending on success or failure conditions.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up all handles in the pool during object destruction.
